mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a decline in payroll employment, signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment and declining payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during periods of low inflation.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
